plan.objective: Restore the full-body target distribution that min_face_res=192 discarded.
plan.hypothesis: The filter removed 96% of cosmic's full-body imagery (36,843 of 38,197), so every CL arm trained on an almost purely portrait-framed corpus and never learned to place a small face on a full body. The failing prompts are exactly the wide-framing ones.
plan.single_scientific_change: min_face_res 192->64 plus scale-balanced target sampling over face-area bands [2,5,10,20]%
plan.fixed_contract: 24k steps, batch 2, one A100, fixed full96 at step 0 and every 2k, shadow pretrained-default validation, hard spatial BA r128 + generic r32 + PhotoMaker-default r64 at 1e-4, masked_loss_step=1, pose_adapt_ratio=0, ca_mixing_for_face=false, 2240 tensors / 219,217,920 params, reference mirroring off, pose-first captions capped at 50
plan.primary_metric: FACE SCALE: count of images whose detected face is below 0.8 of the fixed mask box, via tools/datasets/measure_face_body_alignment.py at MATCHED steps. E13=0, CL2=1, CL4=6, CL0=10, CL3=12. id_sim is explicitly secondary.

decision_gates.step_4000: undersized count below CL4's 6; id_sim within 0.02 of CL4
decision_gates.step_8000: jensen/jisoo/keanu undersized counts trending to zero

preflight.note: full-body framing restored: 54% of sampled targets below 5% face area vs CL4's 6%
